summary: Machine-readable carryforward obligation matrix reconciling incomplete live acceptance, post-deploy observation windows, human authorities, and orphan PR dispositions.
principles: Code delivery, live runtime verification, and human authority sign-off are distinct states; an archived engineering done does not imply live done.
Pre-production gates must not circularly depend on post-production observation windows.
NFR observation windows (24h, 7 business days, 1 full calendar month) must be bound to their respective post-deployment stages without fake numbers.
Release gate registry and manifest remain the sole canonical release truth.

obligations.title: Secret and Identity Isolation Across Environments (dev, staging, prod)
required_receipts: In-WIF job SHA256 digest of secret versions (gcloud secrets versions access ... | sha256sum) with zero secret values exported
gcloud run services/jobs describe output proving dev/staging resources do not execute under production Service Account
Verification that dev and staging secret digests do not match production secret digests
obligations.trigger_condition: Runtime Release deploy job conclusion 'success' in each environment
obligations.disposition_notes: Static configuration identity reference fingerprints verified distinct in rollout-readback.json; runtime secret value digests require live deployed environments.

obligations.title: API Latency & Concurrency Performance SLA (P95 <= 3.0s, 0 errors)
required_receipts: Load test execution report on deployed oday-api measuring P95 <= 3.0s, 0 failures at concurrency 10/20/50 (150 requests/round)
Cloud Monitoring run.googleapis.com/request_latencies P95 telemetry over at least 24 hours of live traffic
obligations.trigger_condition: Live deployment of runtime candidate on staging/production with real/staged traffic
obligations.disposition_notes: Deterministic load_soak_performance_report.json is an offline test, not runtime proof. Staging load pass gates production admission; production 24h window observed post-rollout.

obligations.title: Daily Batch Completion SLA Before Operating Day
required_receipts: gcloud run jobs executions list --job=oday-worker-r-<release> completion logs showing succeeded status across 7 operating days
Human/Ops formal written specification of the daily operating day cutoff time
obligations.trigger_condition: Live production deployment running scheduled daily batch jobs over 7 operating days
obligations.disposition_notes: Operating day cutoff deadline is NOT defined in repo and requires Human/Ops input. 7-day observation is post-production and does not block pre-production admission.

obligations.title: OpsBoard Monthly Availability SLA >= 99.5%
required_receipts: Cloud Monitoring uptime check on production oday-web OpsBoard route reporting uptime_check/check_passed ratio >= 0.995 for one full calendar month
obligations.trigger_condition: 1 full calendar month elapsed following live production deployment
obligations.disposition_notes: Post-production availability monitoring window. Cannot be measured prior to production launch; non-circular.

obligations.disposition_notes: Local shutil.copy drill in dr_drill_records.json is an offline test; runtime Cloud SQL restore drill on staging required.
